initial_profile.target: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the declared customer population, estimated by all-sample AIPW scores; not mean fitted CATE.
initial_profile.law: Complete independent customer rows; one binary action, one fixed scalar outcome and horizon.
initial_profile.assumption_status: Declared premises; neither syntax nor fitting verifies them.

initial_options.seed: Required integer, recorded; no default random draw

initial_profile.nuisance: Retain R OOB nuisance path; optional declared known randomized propensity only. Supplied fitted nuisances need a separately qualified provenance/split profile.
excluded: Weights or clusters in initial profile
External fitted nuisance vectors in initial profile
initial_profile.extension: Independent-cluster all-sample AIPW design retains cluster units and target weights; no current admission or few-cluster coverage.

inputs: Immutable request identity, feature order, customer keys, action/outcome coding, units and fixed horizon.
Explicit all-population AIPW target; no silent treated/control/overlap substitution.
Nuisance origin, fold/time provenance, seed and thread configuration; external fitted vectors excluded initially.
outputs: Target, population and actual estimator identifier, scalar score aggregate and separately labeled standard error.
All warnings and support diagnostics, original request hash, completed status and provenance.
CATE predictions, R-loss, Monte Carlo error and confidence statements remain separate typed fields.
exclusions: Weights or clusters in initial profile
External fitted nuisance vectors in initial profile

failures.unavailable: Current state: engine/dependency/admission receipt absent; no numeric result.
failures.unsupported: Recognized query outside profile; explain sampling/target mismatch and reviewed alternative.
failures.refused: Support or identification prerequisites fail under declared profile; retain diagnostics and target.
failures.not_identified: Only with an audited identification failure; inability of adapter is not proof.
failures.failed: Nonfinite result, corrupt model, subprocess error, timeout or resource failure; no partial numeric estimate.
failures.computed: Only admitted runtime result with original context and units, scalar AIPW target, provenance; uncertainty no stronger than bound evidence.
failures.sets: Preserve unknown/empty/disconnected/unbounded sets from applicable methods; this forest route cannot fabricate a finite interval for them.

prototype_oracles.anchor: Existing exact conversion and variance oracle

qualification: Run original R package on declared data only after environment preparation.
Compare supplied fixed-score fixtures, actual predictions, aggregation, serialization and refusal/fault behavior.
Test warnings, target/method combinations, OOB versus newdata, and time/fold leakage guards.
Register separate public-data calibration and cost studies; retain failed fits in the denominator.
